name: USDA county yield atlas crop-region interval scaling candidate

protocol.champion: atlas v10 crop/history radii with Census-region scales
protocol.candidate: crop/history radii with separately selected crop-region scales
protocol.rule: Select the smallest crop-region scale meeting nominal coverage in both development and stability; sparse groups retain v10. Require >=4% narrower pooled 90% bands, calibrated pooled/stability/final blocks, reliable crop and region slices, and no final region above 98% 90%-coverage.

decision: reject; retain atlas v10 regional interval scales
interpretation: Observed county-rank uncertainty; not parcel yield, revenue, or property value.
